NGA.note: USPF is named as an implementer of Project 774, but no amount, budget line or statement on paying from own resources is given.
Galaxy Backbone and NigComSat are named as connectivity deliverers; no system run or built by government staff is stated.

facts.fact: Minister Bosun Tijani said the Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy ministry will deliver Project 774, connecting all 774 local government headquarters, through Galaxy Backbone, NigComSat and the USPF.
The minister said the 2027 target for reaching all 774 local governments is spread out in a published blueprint for Project 774.

Kogi State's information commissioner said the project has started and some local government areas in the state already benefit, while the minister said the remaining headquarters would be connected by 2027; no count of connected offices is given.

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy
